`lame.min.js` is the unmodified browser build from lamejs 1.2.1,
downloaded from https://registry.npmjs.org/lamejs/-/lamejs-1.2.1.tgz.
Its license is included in `lamejs-LICENSE`.
The local server runs it in a worker to convert uploaded 16-bit PCM WAV
to mono 22.05 kHz / 96 kbps MP3 before Mureka's audio upload API.
